## How to Invoice Heatmasters
* * *
Please email your sales invoice directly to our scanning service:  
invoice23162686@kollektor.fi
Unfortunately, we cannot accept paper invoices.
Our invoicing address:  
Heatmasters Oy  
Televisiotie 2  
15860 Hollola  
FINLAND
Business ID, VAT Registration No: FI23162686
Before emailing any sales invoices, please pay attention to the following limitations of our scanning service:  
• The sales invoice needs to be in pdf format.  
• Send only one invoice per email.  
• If you have any attachments to the invoice, they need to be in any other format except pdf. They can be in zip, txt, csv, xlsx or docx format.  
• You will receive an automatic confirmation to your email upon successful delivery of your message.
If you have any questions, please contact us via e-mail: customercare@heatmasters.net
**Gallantly Yours,  
Heatmasters’ Accounting Wizards**
